name: Will-o’-Wisp
summary: A flickering undead light that shocks and feeds on fear.

traits.name: Ephemeral
traits.text: The wisp can't wear or carry anything.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.text: The wisp sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.text: The wisp can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes {dmg:1d10:force} if it ends its turn inside an object.

bonusActions.name: Consume Life

save.targets: one living creature the wisp can see within 5 feet that has 0 Hit Points

bonusActions.onFailure: The target dies, and the wisp regains {dmg:3d6} Hit Points.

bonusActions.name: Vanish
bonusActions.text: The wisp and its light have the Invisible condition until the wisp's Concentration ends on this effect, which ends early immediately after the wisp makes an attack roll or uses Consume Life.
